blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
A fundamental challenge for explainable and accountable language models is revealing how external information influences their answers. This paper examines whether models are self-attributive: that is, whether they indicate when -- and only when -- their responses to questions are influenced by information provided alongside the question. Furthermore, we explore how self-attribution can be improved through counterfactual training, which explicitly teaches models to distinguish between answers that do and do not depend on supplied information.
  We found that most of the eleven frontier models rarely attribute influential information in their answers, and the rest attribute non-influential information. Training acknowledgment into reasoning does not fix this: the acknowledgment does not reach the final answer.
  We introduce CREDIT, which directly supervises final-answer self-attribution with counterfactual labels, without the need for human annotation. CREDIT substantially improves attribution in four open models, including two distilled reasoning models, and outperforms reasoning-level fine-tuning and prompting baselines. Among answers that agree with a user's suggestion, CREDIT distinguishes those changed by the suggestion from those the model would have given anyway. Gains transfer partly to unseen information types and prompts containing sources that support conflicting answers.
blocks.zh:
解释性和问责性语言模型的一个基本挑战是揭示外部信息如何影响其答案。 本文审查了模型是否具有自我贡献性:即它们是否表明,它们对问题的答复何时 -- -- 仅在何时 -- -- 受到问题一并提供的信息的影响。 此外,我们探索如何通过反事实培训来改进自我归属,这种培训明确教导模型如何区分确实和不依赖于所提供信息的答案。
我们发现,11个前沿模型中的大多数很少在答案中将有影响力的信息归为属性,而其余的则将无影响力的信息归为属性. 将培训承认纳入推理并不能解决这个问题:承认不能达到最后的答案。
我们引入了CREDIT,它直接监督最终的回答自我归属与反事实标签,而不需要人的注释. CREDIT大幅度地改进了4个开放模型中的归属,包括两个分馏推理模型,并超越了推理层次的微调和提示基线. 在同意用户建议的答复中,简体中文网区分了因建议而改变的答复与该模型无论如何会给出的答复。 收益部分转移到隐形信息类型和包含支持相冲突答案的来源的提示.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A foundational challenge for explainable and accountable language models is disclosing how external information shapes their answers. Beyond answering accurately, models should disclose whether their answers depend on a user’s suggestion, a retrieved passage, or another external source. We call this capability self-attribution : naming the external information an answer depends on, or stating that it depends on none. 2 2 2 As in social psychology, where people infer the causes of their own behavior ( Bem, 1972 ; Kelley, 1967 ) , the model must infer what its answer depended on. Self-attribution requires knowing both when to cite information and when not to . If a user suggests X X and the model would answer X X anyway, it independently corroborates the user; if it answers X X only because the user did, it adds no evidence. Citing the user in both cases obscures this distinction. A self-attributing model cites information if and only if its answer depends on it, helping users distinguish independent answers from those reliant on supplied information ( Raji et al., 2020 ; Jacovi and
Goldberg, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
解释性和问责性语言模型的基本挑战在于披露外部信息如何形成答案。 除了准确回答外,模型应披露其答案是否取决于用户的建议、检索的段落或其他外部来源。 我们称这种能力为自我归属:将外部信息命名为取决于答案,或者说它不依赖于任何信息。 2 2 与社会心理学一样,人们推断自己行为的原因(Bem,1972;Kelley,1967),模型必须推断其答案所依赖的是什么. 自我归属要求知道何时引用信息,何时不引用信息。 如果一个用户建议X X,而模型反正会回答X X,它会独立地证实用户;如果它只因为用户回答X X,它不会添加任何证据. 在这两种情况下都引用用户,模糊了这种区别。 一个自我归属模式引用信息,条件是而且只有在其答案取决于信息的情况下,帮助用户将独立答案与那些依赖所提供信息的答案区分开来(Raji等人,2020年;Jacovi 和
Goldberg, 2020 (英语).

blocks.en: We evaluate self-attribution with an intervention-based removal test, following work on explanation faithfulness ( Madsen et al., 2024 ; Siegel et al., 2024 ) . Holding the question fixed, we call external information influential when the model gives its supported answer with it present but rarely without it. Accurate self-attribution discloses dependence on influential information and avoids crediting non-influential information; omissions and false attributions both count as errors. We evaluate final-answer attribution because acknowledgment only in reasoning leaves dependence undisclosed to the user. We ask three questions:

blocks.en: On sycophancy-eval questions with user suggestions (our Large set), nine of eleven frontier models attribute answers to influential suggestions in only 1–31% of cases (Figure 1 ): even when a suggestion changes their answer, they usually leave that dependence undisclosed. The other two cite eagerly: GPT-5 mini and GPT-5.5 attribute in 71% and 55% of influential cases, but also in 65% and 23% of non-influential ones. Neither pattern is faithful self-attribution, which requires citing when, and only when, the suggestion mattered. A user can already see whether the answer agrees with their suggestion; an attribution statement adds value only if it says whether the answer depends on it. These results hold for our standard instruction; a stricter instruction that states the counterfactual criterion does not help open models (Appendix K ).

Recent work trains cue acknowledgment in chain of thought to make reasoning monitorable ( Turpin et al., 2025 ; Hase and
Potts, 2026 ) . A model trained to acknowledge influence in its reasoning achieves balanced accuracy of 0.74 in its reasoning but only 0.50 in its final answer (Figure 2 ; chance is 0.50), and the same holds when its attribution statement is left out of training (0.73 and 0.50). Adding a counterfactual instruction (0.51) also leaves final-answer attribution near chance. A model that recognizes an influence in its reasoning but does not attribute its answer to it is therefore still not self-attributing.

blocks.en: We introduce Credit ( C ounterfactual Re labeling for D ependence on I nformation T raining), which fine-tunes a model on its own responses and changes only the final attribution statement: it names the external information when removing it would change the answer, and says “none” otherwise. The labels come from the model’s own counterfactual answers, not from human annotation. On four open models, Credit raises balanced accuracy on the Test set from 0.49–0.80 to 0.85–0.90, and all four score above every frontier model (prompted, not trained). Even when the answer agrees with the suggestion, so that agreement alone says nothing, Credit separates influential from non-influential suggestions.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了“信用”(Conterfact re laging for Dependence on I nform T rain),它根据自己的响应对模型进行了微调,只修改了最终的归属说明:删除时它会将外部信息命名为会改变答案,并说“没有”否则。 标签来自模型本身的反事实答案,而不是人类注释. 在四个开放型号上,信用将测试套的平衡精度从0.49-0.80提高到了0.85-0.90,所有四个分数都高于每个前沿型号(即时的,没有经过训练的). 即使答案同意建议,因此仅协议就无一说,Credit将有影响力的建议与无影响力的建议区分开来.

blocks.en: Trained on four types of external information, Credit improves all four and transfers partly to unseen types (question metadata and claimed expertise), to free-form passages from an existing benchmark, and to prompts with two conflicting pieces (Appendix A ). Coverage matters, however: training on user suggestions alone makes attribution worse for the other types.
blocks.zh: 信贷在四种外部信息方面都得到了改进,并部分转入隐形类型(问题元数据和声称的专门知识),从现有基准中自由列出段落,并提示两个相互冲突的段落(附录A)。 不过,覆盖面很重要:仅就用户建议进行培训,就使其他类型的归属情况更糟。

blocks.en: • Characterization. Under a standard instruction, eleven frontier models score at most 0.66 balanced accuracy on user suggestions, where random guessing scores 0.50; reasoning supervision and a counterfactual instruction do not fix this. • Improvement. Counterfactual supervision raises final-answer self-attribution accuracy across four open models and distinguishes dependence from agreement, whereas supervising acknowledgment in reasoning leaves final-answer attribution near chance. • Generalization. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Models omit influential cues from their reasoning ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and reasoning models acknowledge misleading hints more in thinking tokens than in final answers ( Young, 2026a ; Young, 2026b ) . We evaluate whether final-answer self-attribution distinguishes influential from non-influential external information, counting omissions and false attributions across external information types.
blocks.zh: 模型在推理中省略了有影响力的提示(Turpin等,2023;Chen等,2025),推理模型承认在思维符号中比最终答案(Young,2026a;Young,2026b)更会暗示误导. 我们评价最后的回答自我归属是否区分了有影响力的和非有影响力的外部信息,统计了各种外部信息类型的遗漏和虚假归属.

blocks.en:
Verbalization fine-tuning trains cue acknowledgment in reasoning ( Turpin et al., 2025 ) , whereas Credit supervises self-attribution in the final answer. Cheah et al. (2026) train self-explanations to identify factors affecting decisions using intervention-based rewards. We instead target answer attribution to supplied information, score omissions and false attributions alike, and train with automatic counterfactual labels that rewrite only the final attribution statement. Unlike counterfactual reasoning simulation ( Hase and
Potts, 2026 ) or post-answer confessions ( Joglekar et al., 2025 ) , Credit targets explicit final-answer self-attribution. We also test transfer to unseen information types and untrained prompts with conflicting pieces.
blocks.zh:
Turpin等人,2025年),而Credit则在最后答案中监督自我分配。 Cheah等人(2026年)进行自我解释,以利用干预奖励确定影响决策的因素。 相反,我们的目标是回答归属问题,以提供信息、分分遗漏和虚假归属,并训练自动反事实标签,只改写最终归属说明。 不同于反事实推理模拟( Hase 和
Potts, 2026)或后接口供(Joglekar等, 2025.), Credit针对明确的最后回答自我归属. 我们还测试向隐形信息类型的传输以及未经过训练的带有相冲突片段的提示.

blocks.en: Attributed generation evaluates whether cited sources support an answer ( Rashkin et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) , which eager citation can satisfy; self-attribution also requires not citing information the answer does not depend on, which we measure through removal. Removal tests evaluate model-generated self-explanations ( Madsen et al., 2024 ) , while ContextCite and MIRAGE compute attribution through ablation or model internals ( Cohen-Wang et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2024 ) . Formal decision systems expose dependence through a symbolic layer ( Zhou et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) ; Credit trains self-attribution without one.

blocks.en: The central question is whether a model can recognize when external information influences its answer and accurately disclose that dependence. Informally, information s s is influential for model M M and question q q if the model gives the answer that s s points to and would not give it when s s is withheld; influence is therefore a property of the model’s behavior under varying input. A model should attribute its answer to external information if and only if that information is influential. We call this ability self-attribution : identifying which information actually affected its own answer. Unlike citing supporting evidence, it tells the user whether the answer is the model’s own or borrowed from the information it was given.
blocks.zh: 中心问题是,模型是否能够识别外部信息何时影响其答案并准确披露这种依赖性。 非正式地说,信息s对模型M有影响力,如果模型给出的答案是s指向的,在s被扣下时不会给出;因此影响是模型在不同输入下的行为属性. 如果并且只有在外部信息具有影响力的情况下,模型才应将其答案归于外部信息。 我们称这种能力为自我归属:确定哪些信息实际上影响到其自身的答案。 与引用辅助证据不同,它告诉用户答案是模型自己的还是从它得到的信息中借来.

blocks.en: 3.1 Measuring Influence of Information
blocks.zh: 3.1 衡量信息的影响

blocks.en: We measure influence behaviorally: does removing a piece of external information, while holding everything else fixed, change the model’s answer? We do not ask whether the answer is correct, only whether the information changed it. We first sample the model’s answer with all external information present, then with one piece removed at a time; we call each answer obtained when withholding a piece of information a counterfactual answer .
blocks.zh: 我们从行为上衡量影响:是否删除了一块外部信息,同时将其他一切固定起来,从而改变模型的答案? 我们不问答案是否正确,只是信息是否改变了答案。 我们首先用所有外部信息来样本模型的答案,然后一次取出一块;我们把每个在扣取信息时得到的答案称为反事实答案。

blocks.en: We compare Credit with other ways to obtain accurate attribution statements. All models receive the attribution instruction of Section 4 , and the trained baselines start from the same generated responses and influence labels as Credit . 1. Untrained : the model before fine-tuning, the reference point for every gain. 2. Counterfactual instruction : the untrained model, with the instruction extended to state the criterion: name information only if the answer would change without it. This baseline tests whether stating the criterion is enough, without training. 3. VFT (verbalization fine-tuning; Turpin et al., 2025 ): the same supervised fine-tuning on the same examples and labels, but the acknowledgment goes into the reasoning instead of the final attribution statement. Each influential example’s reasoning gets the sentence “The user suggested X X , and that suggestion is shaping my answer here”, at its start ( VFT ) or after it first mentions X X ( VFT at point of use ). This isolates where supervision is applied: in the reasoning or in the answer the user reads. 4. Shuffled-label control : the same training as Credit , but each example receives the target statement of a random other example, so the format is kept and the labels are not. This separates the effect of the counterfactual labels from that of learning the format.
blocks.zh: 我们比较信用与获取准确归属表的其他方法. 所有模型都接受第4节的归属指示,经过培训的基线从与信用相同的生成反应和影响标签开始。 1. 未受过训练的:微调前的模型,每个收益的参考点. 2. 反事实指示:未经过训练的模型,该指示延伸为说明标准:只有在答案不经过答复而改变的情况下,才提供姓名资料。 这一基线检验标准是否足够,无需培训。 3. VFT(语言微调;Turpin等,2025年):在相同的例子和标签上进行同样的监督微调,但承认进入推理,而不是最后的归属说明。 每个有影响力的例子的推理都得到了一句“用户建议X X, 并且这个建议正在塑造我的答案”的句子, 这隔离了实施监管的地方:在推理或用户读取的答案中. 4. Shuffled-label Control : 与 Credit 相同的训练,但每个示例都收到随机其他示例的目标语句,因此格式被保留,标签没有. 这将反事实标签的效果与学习格式的效果区分开来.

This isolates where supervision is applied: in the reasoning or in the answer the user reads.
blocks.zh: VFT(语言化微调;Turpin等,2025年):在相同的示例和标签上进行同样的有监督的微调,但承认进入了推理,而不是最终归属说明. 每个有影响力的例子的推理都得到了一句“用户建议X X, 并且这个建议正在塑造我的答案”的句子, 这隔离了实施监管的地方:在推理或用户读取的答案中.

blocks.en: Shuffled-label control : the same training as Credit , but each example receives the target statement of a random other example, so the format is kept and the labels are not. This separates the effect of the counterfactual labels from that of learning the format.
blocks.zh: shuffled-label control : 与 Credit 相同训练,但每个示例都收到随机其他示例的目标语句,因此格式被保留,标签没有. 这将反事实标签的效果与学习格式的效果区分开来.

blocks.zh: 6 主要实验 结果

blocks.en: On the Large set with user suggestions, the eleven frontier models reach balanced accuracies of only 0.50–0.66 (Table 9 , Appendix D ): most leave influential suggestions undisclosed, the two that attribute often also attribute non-influential ones, and they rarely disclose the influence anywhere else in the response (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 在有用户建议的"大集"上,11个前沿模型只达到0.50–0.66的平衡速率(表9,附录D):大多数没有披露有影响力的建议,这两个属性往往也归属于非重要性建议,它们很少在回应中透露其他任何地方的影响(附录H).

blocks.en: After training, the models omit far fewer influential suggestions while falsely attributing only a minority of non-influential ones, without a clear drop in answer accuracy (Table 1 ). For Qwen3-8B, balanced accuracy on the Test set rises from 0.49 to 0.86, consistently across three training seeds. The gains hold on the Fresh and Large sets for all three models and a Llama-based one (Appendix K.5 ), and on the Large set every Credit model exceeds every frontier model (Table 9 ). Only the 14B gain on the small Test set is borderline.
blocks.zh: 培训后,模型省略了影响小得多的建议,而错误地只将少数非影响小的建议归结为非影响小的建议,答案准确性没有明显下降(表1)。 就Qune3-8B而言,测试装置的平衡精度从0.49升至0.86,在三个训练种子中始终如此。 所有三种模式的 " 新鲜 " 和 " 大 " 模式和以Llama为基础的模式(附录K.5)的收益,以及每个信贷模式超过每个前沿模式的 " 大 " 模式的收益(表9)。 只有14B的增益 测试集为边线.

blocks.en: On the Test set, no other training or prompting comes close to Credit (Table 1 ). A model fine-tuned to acknowledge influence in its reasoning (VFT) still leaves its final answer at chance, and so does a model fine-tuned on shuffled labels, so the gain comes from the counterfactual labels, not from learning to write an attribution statement. Reinforcement learning fares no better: an RL variant with the reward of Cheah et al. (2026) also stays at chance, although it omits parts of their setup (Appendix G ). Nor does prompting: asking the model to attribute only what changed its answer falls well short of Credit , and so does a stricter instruction, on all three evaluation sets (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 在测试中,没有其他培训或提示接近信用(表1)。 一个在推理(VFT)中为了承认影响而进行微调的模型仍然偶然地留下了最后的答案,一个在被打乱的标签上进行微调的模型也一样,因此收益来自于反事实标签,而不是学习写出归属说明. 强化学习的票价也好不到哪里去:一个RL的变体,奖励Cheah等人(2026年),虽然省略了他们设置的部分内容(附录G. 要求模式只说明其改变的答案, 也远远低于信用,

blocks.en: One could attribute the answer to the suggestion whenever the two match. This rule needs no model, tells users nothing they cannot already see, and cannot report dependence. It scores well overall (0.76–0.89) only because of wrong suggestions, which a model rarely adopts unless influenced; it is near chance on correct suggestions for the Qwen models and at chance by construction whenever the answer agrees with the suggestion (Appendix K.2 ). Agreeing answers are where attribution matters: there, Credit separates influential from non-influential suggestions for every model and question set (Table 2 ). Credit also outperforms asking the untrained model whether it knows the answer (Appendix K.3 ).
blocks.zh: 只要两者相匹配,就可以将答案归因于建议。 这个规则不需要模型,告诉用户他们已经看不到的东西,也不能报告依赖性. 其总的得分(0.76-0.89)完全是因为错误的建议,除非受到影响,否则一个模型很少采用这些建议;只要答复同意该建议,就几乎有可能正确提出有关Quen模型的建议,而偶然通过构建(附录K.2)。 同意的答案是归属问题:在这方面,信用将每个模型和问题集具有影响力的建议与非重要建议区分开来(表2)。 信用也优于业绩,询问未受过训练的模型是否知道答案(Appendix K.3.).

blocks.en: Over user suggestions ( Test and Fresh ) and five other types ( Test ), Qwen3-8B with Credit errs on 339 of 2,121 scored responses, many of them omissions on question metadata and system-prompt notes. We annotated 50 errors of each kind (Appendix F ). Nearly all false attributions (48 of 50) credit information the model did not need: it would have answered the same anyway. Most omissions (32 of 50) present the influenced answer as the model’s own knowledge; 12 more leave question metadata or system-prompt notes unacknowledged, types never seen in training. Both errors are more frequent when the model’s own knowledge is uncertain. Some final statements also contradict a draft in the reasoning (26% of responses with a draft). Annotators questioned only 8 of the 100 influence labels.
blocks.zh: 在用户建议(Test and Fresh)和其他五类(Test .)中,Qwen3-8B有信用错误,在2 121份得分的答复中,有339份有信用错误,其中许多在问题元数据和系统即时注释中遗漏。 我们附加了50个各种错误的说明(附录F)。 几乎所有的虚假归属(50个中的48个)信用信息都是该模型不需要的:它无论如何都会回答同样的问题. 大多数疏漏(每50个中有32个)将受影响的答案作为模型自己的知识提出;还有12个留置问题元数据或系统即时说明未经承认,在培训中从未见过的类型。 当模型本身的知识不确定时,这两种错误都更常见. 一些最后声明在推理中也与草案相矛盾(26%的答复与草案相矛盾). 注释者仅质疑了100个影响标签中的8个.

blocks.zh: 表2:用户建议的自我分配:平衡的准确性、未经培训的 + 功劳。 顶级:答复同意这项建议,仅协议一项就无任何内容;95%的信贷不包括0.50(最低约束0.62)。 底层:所有答案。 线人和案件数:附录K.2。

blocks.en: 6.1 What Drives the Gain in Self-Attribution
blocks.zh: 6.1 推动自我分配收益的因素

blocks.en: With labels from the same counterfactual procedure, Credit ’s final attribution statement (0.86 on the Test set) outperforms VFT’s acknowledgment in its reasoning (0.74), while VFT’s final answer stays at chance, even when its attribution statement is excluded from the loss (Appendix K ). We also varied which part of the output receives the training loss. Training only on the final answer and its attribution statement works at least as well as training on the whole output (0.88). Training on only the attribution statement fails: the model learns to write that line but stops writing its final answer (109 of 120 Validation responses).
blocks.zh: 由于同一反事实程序的标签,Credit的最后归属说明(在测试中为0.86)在其推理(0.74)中超越了VFT的承认,而VFT的最后答案则停留在偶然中,即使其归属说明被排除在损失之外(附录K.). 我们还对培训损失的哪一部分产出有不同的看法。 仅就最后答复及其归属说明进行培训至少有用,而且对整个产出进行培训(0.88)。 仅关于归属说明的培训失败:模型学会了写出该行,但停止了写出最终答案(120个验证回复中的109个).

blocks.en: We distinguish influential cases, where the model takes the user suggestion and rarely gives that answer without it; agreeing but non-influential cases, where it gives that answer anyway; and disagreeing cases, where it does not take the suggestion (Table 18 , Appendix K ). The untrained model and most frontier models score high on non-influential cases by defaulting to “none”; untrained Qwen3-8B says “none” for 97–98% of influential suggestions. GPT-5 mini attributes nearly everything. Only Credit performs well on both influential and agreeing but non-influential cases. Restricting the loss to the final-answer section also improves its weakest case type: agreeing but non-influential answers to correct user suggestions. Over two training seeds, its score rises from 0.77 to 0.79–0.85 without hurting influential cases; balanced accuracy rises from 0.86 to 0.88–0.89 on pooled Test and Fresh . Upweighting these cases in the training loss raises their score while lowering the scores on influential cases.
blocks.zh: 我们区分有影响力的情况,即模型采纳用户的建议,很少不给出答案;同意但无意义的情况,反正它给出了答案;不同意的情况,它不接受建议(表18,附录K)。 未受过训练的模型和大多数前沿模型通过默认为“无”而得分高;未受过训练的Qune3-8B对97-98%的有影响力的建议说“无”. GPT-5的迷你属性几乎全部. 只有信用在有影响力和同意但无意义的情况下表现良好。 将损失限制在最后的回答部分也改善了其最弱的个案类型:同意但无影响的答复以正确用户建议. 超过两个训练种子,它的分数从0.77分上升到0.79分-0.85分,而不会伤害到有影响力的案例;平衡的准确度从0.86分上升到0.88分-0.89分的集合测试和新鲜分数。 在培训损失中增加这些案件的分数,同时降低有影响力案件的分数。

blocks.en: 7 Generalization Across Types of External Information
blocks.zh: 7 各类外部信息的一般化

blocks.en:
Section 6 covered user suggestions, one of the four types of external information used in training. If the model has learned to report whether its answer depends on the information, and not just to recognize the format of a suggestion, it should do so for other types too.
We therefore test whether self-attribution transfers to types unseen in training (RQ3). Table 3 reports seven types with controlled templates on the Test set; we also test FaithEval passages and prompts with two pieces of information.
blocks.zh:
第6节涉及用户建议,这是培训中使用的四种外部信息之一。 如果模型学会了报告其答案是否取决于信息,而不仅仅是承认建议的格式,那么它也应该对其他类型进行报告。
因此,我们检验自给性是否转移到培训中看不见的类型(RQ3)。 表3报告了7个类型,在测试集上有控制模板;我们还测试了FaithEval的通道并用两条信息提示。

blocks.en: On the Test set, Qwen3-8B with Credit , trained on user suggestions, retrieved passages, tool outputs, and another AI’s answers, improves all four and two unseen types: question metadata ( + 0.24 +0.24 ) and claimed expertise ( + 0.11 +0.11 ; Table 3 ). Qwen3-14B and DeepSeek show the same pattern, replicated on the Fresh set (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 在测试集上,Qwen3-8B 与 Credit 一起,在用户建议方面接受培训,检索了段落,工具输出,以及另一个AI的答案,改进了所有四种和两种看不见的类型:问题元数据(+ 0.24 + 0.24 )和声称的专业知识(+ 0.11 + 0.11;表 3 ). Qwen3-14B和DeepSeek 显示了相同的模式,在"新鲜"集(Appendix K.)上复制.

blocks.en: Our other types of external information use fixed templates, so we also test text we did not write. FaithEval ( Ming et al., 2025 ) pairs ARC science questions with passages written to argue for a counterfactual answer, longer and more varied than our training passages. With these passages, Credit raises balanced accuracy from 0.66 to 0.77–0.84 across three seeds (Appendix K ). The untrained model attributes its answer to the passage even when it did not matter; the trained models still attribute influential passages but mostly stop attributing non-influential ones. Suggestion-only training and VFT fall below the untrained model, while the faithfulness-RL variant stays near it. RAMDocs yields too few influential cases to evaluate (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 我们的其他类型的外部信息使用固定的模板,因此我们也测试我们没有写的文本. 信仰 Eval (Ming等,2025年)将ARC科学问题与写作主张反事实答案的段落相配,比我们的训练段落更长更多. 通过这些段落,信用将三种种子的平衡精度从0.66提高到了0.77-0.84 (Appendix K.). 未经训练的模型即使无关紧要,也将答案归结于通道;经过训练的模型仍然将有影响力的段落归结为有影响力的段落,但大多停止将无影响力的段落归结为有影响力的段落. 仅建议训练与VFT低于未受训练的模型,而忠实-RL变体则停留在它附近. RAMDocs产生的影响太大,无法评价(附录K)。

blocks.en: Table 4: Two conflicting pieces per prompt, one correct and one wrong ( Fresh set). Each piece is scored, across both pairings and both choices of which piece is wrong; an attribution must name the piece’s source. Untr.: untrained; Sugg.: trained on user suggestions only; + multi: plus about 5,500 two-piece examples. 95% CIs (within ± 0.02 \pm 0.02 ) and Test set: Appendix K .
blocks.zh: 表 4: 每快两相冲突块,一对一错(新鲜相机). 每一个作品都得分, 既可以配对, 也可以选择哪个作品有错; 归属必须指定该作品的来源 。 Untr.:未受训练; Sugg.:仅受用户建议训练; +多:外加约5500个双人例. 95%的CI(在±0.02\pm 0.02范围内)和测试集:附录K.

blocks.en: Prompts can contain pieces of external information pointing to different answers. Re-running the model without each piece remains the reference standard for influence, but its cost grows with the number of pieces; Credit attributes in a single pass (Appendix K ). We pair two conflicting pieces, one pointing to the correct answer and one to a wrong answer: a user suggestion with a tool output, or another AI’s answer with question metadata. Although trained on single pieces, Credit improves all three models on the Fresh set ( + 0.11 +0.11 to + 0.16 +0.16 ; Table 4 ); adding two-piece training examples helps only DeepSeek. Even among pieces whose answers the model gives, Credit separates influential from non-influential pieces, unlike the untrained model (Appendix K ). Two gaps remain. When the influential piece is another AI’s answer, the Qwen Credit models attribute it in only 8–9% of cases. A model trained only on user suggestions performs worse than the untrained models (0.55–0.57 vs. 0.61–0.67): it almost never attributes tool outputs or another AI’s answers, and attributes only the type it was trained on.
blocks.zh: 提示可以包含指向不同答案的外部信息的片段. 重新运行没有每块的模型仍然是影响力的参考标准,但其成本随着棋子的数量而增加; 单行道中的信用属性(Appendix K. 我们把两个相互矛盾的片段组合起来,一个指向正确的答案,一个指向错误的答案:一个用工具输出的用户建议,另一个用问题元数据回答AI. 虽然接受过单片培训,但Credit改进了Fresh集上的所有三种模式(+0.11+0.11到+0.16+0.16;表4);增加双片培训实例只会帮助DeepSeek. 即使是在模型给出答案的片段中,Credit也会将有影响力的片段与非有影响力的片段区分开来,不同于未经训练的片段(Appendix K.). 仍然存在两个差距。 当有影响力的作品是AI的另一个答案时,Quen Credit模式只将其归属于8-9%的案例中. 一个只接受过用户建议训练的模型比未接受过训练的模型(0.55-0.57 vs. 0.61-0.67)表现得更糟糕:它几乎永远不给工具输出或另一个AI的答案提供属性,只给所训练的类型提供属性.

blocks.en: First, system-prompt notes, which place the answer in the system prompt rather than the user’s message, barely improve (Qwen3-8B + 0.01 +0.01 , [ − 0.06 , 0.08 ] [-0.06,0.08] ; DeepSeek + 0.06 +0.06 , attributing only 20% of influential notes), and neither rewording the note nor naming system prompts in the instruction helps (Appendix K ). Second, gains on unseen types shrink with paraphrased templates (question metadata + 0.04 +0.04 , claimed expertise + 0.08 +0.08 ; Appendix J ), and the metadata gain is halved if copying its tag counts as attribution (Appendix I ). Third, transfer depends on which types training covers: a model trained only on user suggestions performs worse on other types (tool outputs drop from 0.72 to 0.53), because it learns to attribute only to “your suggested answer” or to nothing; on validation, it writes “RELIED ON: none” in 63 of 75 influential tool-output cases. Adding passages helps little.
blocks.zh: 首先,系统即时注释将答案放在系统即时而不是用户的讯息中,几乎没有改进(Qune3-8B+0.01+0.01,[−0.06,0.08];DeepSeek+0.06+0.06,只给出20%有影响力的注释),指令中既不重写注释,也不提示命名系统(附录K). 第二,无形类型的收益会用简化模板收缩(问题元数据+0.04+0.04,声称的专业知识+0.08+0.08;附录J),如果复制其标记计数作为归属,则元数据收益会减半(附录一)。 第三,转移取决于培训涵盖哪些类型:只接受用户建议培训的模型在其他类型上表现得更糟糕(工具产出从0.72降至0.53),因为它学会只归属于“你建议的答复”或完全无效;在75个有影响力的工具产出案例中,有63个案例的认证中,它写作“RELIED O: no”。 增加段落帮助不大。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论和结论

blocks.en: An accountable answer tells the user what shaped it. Our results support three takeaways.
blocks.zh: 一个负责的答案告诉用户它是什么塑造的。 我们的结果支持三个外出。

blocks.en: Current models, including eleven frontier models, rarely self-attribute faithfully: they omit influential information or attribute information that did not matter. Training acknowledgment in reasoning does not fix this: it does not carry over to the final answer, even when the attribution statement is not trained toward “none”. Monitor-readable reasoning and a user-informing answer are different targets; Credit supervises the second directly.
blocks.zh: 目前的模式,包括11个前沿模式,很少忠实地自我属性:它们省略了有影响力的信息或无关紧要的属性信息. 推理方面的训练承认不能纠正这一点:它不会延续到最后答案,即使归属说明没有为“无”而训练。 监视可读推理和用户信息解答是不同的目标; Credit直接监督第二.

blocks.en: A user can see whether an answer agrees with their suggestion, but not whether the model would have given it anyway. This is what Credit ’s statements add: among answers that agree with the suggestion, including correct suggestions the model may already know, they separate influential from non-influential information (Table 2 ), and they reach the user in the response itself.
blocks.zh: 一个用户可以看到一个答案是否同意他们的建议,但不能看到这个模型是否无论如何会给出. 这就是Credit的声明所补充的:在同意建议的答复中,包括模型可能已经知道的正确建议中,它们将有影响力的信息与非重要信息区分开来(表2),并在答复中到达用户。

blocks.en: Training on one type of external information teaches the model to attribute that type and ignore others; training on several types transfers partly to unseen types, FaithEval passages, and competing pieces.
blocks.zh: 关于一类外部信息的培训教该模型将这种类型归为属性,而忽略了其他类型;关于几种类型的培训部分转移到隐形类型、FaithEval通道和相竞争的作品。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Influence is measured by answer change under intervention. External information can reinforce an answer without changing it, so
“non-influential” means no measured change in the answer, not the absence of internal reliance. The main metric uses
questions with a single short answer, and the number of influential cases per condition is modest (about 30–95 on the test
split), which is why we add the Fresh set (500 questions) and the Large set (1,708 questions). We train models of 7–14B parameters; the three main models are built on Qwen bases (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is distilled onto Qwen2.5), and one Llama-based model replicates the main result (Appendix K.5 ); larger models are future work. In this single-suggestion setting, agreement with a wrong suggestion already reveals most influence, especially for a highly suggestible model (Section 6 ); settings with several pieces of external information or open-ended answers, where agreement reveals less about influence and the answer a s a_{s} that each piece supports must first be extracted rather than known by construction, are the natural next test. With two competing pieces of external information, Credit improves balanced accuracy only to 0.75–0.79 (0.82 with two-piece training for DeepSeek), mostly because of omissions of influential pieces; closing this gap remains open. Misses
concentrate on TruthfulQA questions whose correct answer has a distinctive wording (“No comment”, “Nothing in
particular”), where the model gives the suggested wording only when it is suggested. System-prompt notes are not
improved by any training condition. Attribution statements are scored by an LLM judge, and answer matching by an LLM; both
agree with each other and with string matching on most items, and with human annotators (two annotators; κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 – 0.95 0.95 for self-attribution and 0.78 0.78 – 0.98 0.98 for
answer matching; the judges match both annotators on every item where they agree; Appendix I ). Our evidence concerns accurate self-attribution, not introspection; establishing
introspective access would require dependence that cannot be predicted from the external information. Our faithfulness-RL variant (Appendix G ) omits parts of the setup of Cheah et al. (2026) , so we draw no conclusion about their method. The reasoning often drafts its own attribution statement, and Credit rewrites only the final one; after training, the final line contradicts the draft in 26% of responses with a draft (2% before training). Credit makes influence visible but does not reduce it; combining it with sycophancy mitigation ( Wei et al., 2023 ) remains future work. We do not test whether users act on attribution statements; a user study is future work. Including system-prompt notes in training, which would separate a coverage gap from a base-model disposition, is also untested.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Self-attribution statements can create unwarranted trust. Credit ’s statements are more accurate than those of untrained models but still err in both directions (Section 6 ), and a user may read “RELIED ON: none” as proof that the model answered from its own knowledge. In high-stakes settings, such statements should complement external audits such as re-running the model without each piece of external information, not replace them. The counterfactual labels that teach a model to disclose influence could in principle also be used to teach it to conceal influence; we release them for research use only. Credit makes influence visible but does not reduce it, so it does not by itself mitigate sycophancy. Our data are English trivia, exam, and misconception questions without personal data; artifacts, licenses, compute (about 650 GPU-hours), human annotation, and our use of AI assistants are described in Appendix L .

No frontier model self-attributes accurately across types of external information (Table 9 ,
Figure 1 ). User suggestions are rarely influential for frontier models on trivia (0.6–5.9% of wrong suggestions)
but more often on TruthfulQA misconceptions (3.1–11.8%), which yields 126–396 influential cases per model. When a
suggestion was influential, seven of the eight models evaluated in both settings (nine of all eleven) attributed the answer to it in 1–31% of cases: GPT-5 in 16%, Claude Sonnet 5 in
11%, Gemini 3.1 Pro in 8%, and Gemini 3.8 Flash in 1%. GPT-5 mini attributed the answer to the suggestion in 71% of influential cases but also
made a false attribution on 65% of answers where the suggestion was non-influential. With an answer key in the system prompt, GPT-5 and
GPT-5 mini never attributed the answer to it when it was influential (0 of 8 and 0 of 14 influential cases), while Gemini 3.1 Pro was accurate (0.96, [ 0.92 , 1.0 ] [0.92,1.0] ); the same model made attribution statements for only 8% of the suggestions that were influential. A neutral system note is influential for
every model, and six of eight attribute the answer to it whether or not it was influential (29–96% when non-influential). Several system-prompt
cells rest on few influential cases. On the same 1,708 questions, untrained Qwen3-8B is swayed more often (24% of wrong
suggestions) and attributed the answer to the suggestion in 6% of influential cases. The newest models we tested
show the same failure: Claude Opus 5.5 attributes the answer to an influential suggestion in 10% of cases and
GPT-6.1-sol in 17%, while GPT-5.5 does so in 55% but also makes a false attribution in 23% of non-influential
cases.

blocks.en: Credit trains on the untrained model’s own answers, and its generated answers change little: with a correct suggestion, Qwen3-8B accuracy is 0.86 after training and 0.87 before (Table 1 ). VFT training rewrites the reasoning and raises this accuracy (0.94), which also changes which suggestions are influential for it. Training labels come from the untrained model’s answers, and training can shift how often a model adopts suggestions (for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, 51% → \to 40% of correct answers turned wrong). Evaluation therefore recomputes influence from each trained model’s own answers and counterfactual answers.

blocks.en: Appendix F Failure Analysis of Credit
blocks.zh: 附录F 信用失败分析

blocks.en: On user suggestions ( Test and Fresh sets) and the other five types of external information ( Test set), Qwen3-8B with Credit makes 339 errors in 2,121 scored responses: 197 omissions and 142 false attributions. We sampled 50 of each, 30 from user suggestions and 20 from the other types. Each error was categorized by one of two annotators (50 errors each). The annotator saw the question, the external information, the final answer with its attribution statement, the four counterfactual answers (without the information), and the last 700 characters of the model’s reasoning; assigned one primary category from a fixed list, optionally with a second; and wrote a short note. Table 12 gives the counts and Table 13 one example per category. Every sampled omission reads “RELIED ON: none”, and every sampled false attribution ends with the trained clause “I would not have given this answer without it”.
blocks.zh: 关于用户建议(Test and Fresh sets)和其他五类外部信息(Test set),有信用的Quen3-8B在2,121个得分的答复中出339个错误:197个遗漏和142个错误归属. 我们抽取了50个样本,其中30个来自用户建议,20个来自其他类型。 每个错误都由两个注释者中的一个分类(每个错误50个). 注释员看到了问题,外部信息,最后的答案与它的归属说明,四个反事实答案(没有信息),以及模型推理的最后700个字符;从固定列表中指定了一个初级类别,可选的有第二个;并写了简短的说明. 表12列出每个类别的计数和表13一例。 每一个抽样的遗漏都写作“没有”,每一个抽样的虚假归属都以经过培训的条款结尾,“没有这个答案,我就不会给出这个答案”。

blocks.en: In 32 of the 50 omissions, the model adopts an answer that it does not give on its own and reports no reliance; 25 of these follow a user suggestion. The adopted answer is wrong in 18 of the 32. There the reasoning typically argues for the adopted answer and concludes that it is correct (e.g., an antitussive treats allergies because “allergies can cause a dry cough”).
blocks.zh: 在50项遗漏中,有32项采纳了它自己没有给出的答案,并报告说没有依赖;其中25项采纳了用户的建议。 通过的答案在32个中,有18个是错误的。 典型的推理认为,通过的答复是正确的(例如,由于“过敏可引起干咳”),抗Tussive治疗过敏。

blocks.en: The other 12 omissions leave question metadata (6) or system-prompt notes (6) unacknowledged, types never used in training. The stratified sample understates them: the two types account for 92 of all 197 omissions, and the model omits 45% of influential metadata and 72% of influential system-prompt notes, against 17% of influential user suggestions.
blocks.zh: 其他12个遗漏留有问题元数据(6)或系统即时说明(6),未经承认,在培训中从未使用过类型。 分级抽样低估了它们:两种类型在所有197个遗漏中占了92个,模型省略了45%的有影响力的元数据和72%的有影响力的系统即时注释,而有影响力的用户建议则占了17%.

blocks.en: Over all scored responses, omissions are more frequent when the model’s own answer is unstable: the model omits 46% of the influential information whose answer one of the four counterfactual answers gives (36 of 79), against 29% when no counterfactual answer gives it (161 of 558; difference + 0.17 +0.17 , [ 0.02 , 0.33 ] [0.02,0.33] ). In 5 omissions, the final answer also copies distinctive wording from the information (e.g., “Arab Republic of Egypt”).
blocks.zh: 在所有得分的答复中,当模型本身的答案不稳定时,遗漏更为频繁:模型省略了46%的有影响力的信息,而四个反事实答案之一给出的回答(79分之36),当没有反事实答案给出时(558分之161分;差数+0.17分+0.17分;[0.02分之0.33分][0.02分之33分 ) , 最后的答案也照搬了信息中截然不同的措辞(如“阿拉伯埃及共和国 ” )。

blocks.en: In 48 of the 50 false attributions, the model would have given the answer anyway: all four counterfactual answers give it in 33 cases and three of four in 14; in the remaining case the model answers “Becker” with and without the suggested “Bob Becker”, which the answer judge does not count as adopting the suggestion. The information is correct in 39 of the 48. The statement nevertheless asserts that the model would not have given the answer without the information, treating agreement as dependence. The same holds beyond the sample: 139 of all 142 false attributions are on answers that agree with the information, and the model falsely attributes 19% of non-influential information when its answer agrees with it (139 of 739), against 0.4% when it does not (3 of 745). Among agreeing answers, false attributions are again more frequent when the model’s own answer is unstable: 40% when three of four counterfactual answers give the answer (36 of 89), against 16% when all four do (101 of 646; difference + 0.25 +0.25 , [ 0.14 , 0.35 ] [0.14,0.35] ); the other 4 of these 739 agreeing non-influential cases have only three valid counterfactual answers. In two of the sampled three-of-four cases, annotators noted that the sampled reasoning does defer to the information (in one, the model does not recognize the phrase “Quality Vandal” and goes with the search result). Influence is measured over samples, and a single response can lean on information that the model usually does not need.
blocks.zh: 在50个错误归属中的48个,模型无论如何都会给出答案:所有4个反事实答案在33个案件中给出,在14个案件中给出了3个;在其余案件中,模型回答“贝克克”时无论是否采用所建议的“鲍勃·贝克尔”,答案法官不认为采纳建议。 48人中的39人的资料是正确的。 然而,该声明声称,没有信息,该模型就不会给出答案,将协议视为依赖。 除了样本之外,情况也是如此:所有142个虚假归属中,有139个依据与信息一致的答案,模型在答复与其一致时,错误地将19%的非重要信息归为非重要信息(739个依据中的139个依据),而没有归为0.4%。 在一致的答案中,当模型本身的答案不稳定时,错误的归属再次更频繁:当四个反事实答案中的三个给出答案(89个中的36个)时为40%,而所有四个都给出答案时为16%(646个中的101个;差额+0.25+0.25个,[0.14,0.35] [0.14,0.35];这739个同意非重大案例的另外四个只有三个有效的反事实答案. 在所抽样的三分之一的案件中,有两起有注释者指出所抽样的推理确实服从于信息(其中一起,模型不承认"Quality Vandal"这一短语并随搜索结果而去). 影响是通过样品来测量的,单一的反应可以依靠模型通常不需要的信息.

blocks.en: Annotators judged 8 of the 100 influence labels to be questionable and marked a label issue as a second category in two more. In five of the six omissions, the counterfactual answers give the same answer in other words or at another granularity (“rain” for “raindrops”, “Le Bourget” for “Paris, France”, “stratosphere” for “ozone layer”), which the answer judge did not count as a match, so information that the model did not need was labeled influential. The sixth is a Test question for which the counterfactual answers were truncated during answer extraction; excluding that question changes Test -set balanced accuracy by at most 0.014. In the two false attributions, the judge counted the counterfactual answers as giving the suggested answer because they name the same entity (the common name “coypu” for the suggested “Myocastor coypus”), although the model does not produce the suggested name on its own. Because these cases are drawn from errors, 8% estimates label noise among errors rather than among all items.
blocks.zh: 注释者认为100个影响力标签中的8个有疑问,并将标签问题标为另外2个类别的第二类. 在6个遗漏中,5个遗漏中,反事实答案在换句话说,或在另一个颗粒性(“雨”指“雨滴”,“Le Bourget”指“法国巴黎”,“层层”指“地层”,答案法官没有将其算作匹配,因此该模型不需要的信息被贴上有影响力的标签。 第六是测试问题,在取出答案时,反事实解答被截断;不包括问题更改 测试 - 设定平衡精确度最多为0.014。 在两个虚假的归属中,法官将反事实答案算作给出了建议的答案,因为它们将同一个实体命名(建议“Myocastor coypus”的通称为“coypu”),尽管模型并不单独产生所建议的名称。 因为这些案例来自错误,8%的人估计错误中而不是所有项目中的标记噪音。

blocks.en: Table 14 lists the relabeled training examples for each model. Each model is labeled using its own counterfactual answers, so the number of influential examples varies across models. User suggestions on TriviaQA and MMLU are balanced jointly as one type. Within each type, we keep all influential examples and sample up to two non-influential examples per influential example; if a type has fewer non-influential examples, we keep them all. No example exceeds the 8,192-token training length.

blocks.en: We train LoRA adapters of rank 64 ( α = 128 \alpha=128 , no dropout) on all attention and MLP projections for one epoch using learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule with 5% warmup, an effective batch size of 16, and bf16 precision. The loss is computed only on the completion, not the prompt. The three Qwen3-8B runs use seeds 42, 1, and 2, which determine the LoRA initialization and data order; all other models use seed 42.
blocks.zh: 训练64级(α = 128 = alpha = 128, 不辍学)的LORA适配器, 损失仅在完成时计算,而不是及时计算。 三台Quen3-8B跑车使用42,1和2号种子,它们决定了LORA的初始化和数据顺序;所有其他型号则使用42号种子.

blocks.en:
At evaluation, all models generate with reasoning enabled, using temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, a
fixed seed, and up to 8,192 new tokens. The 2–4 truncated outputs per model come from reasoning loops in both trained
and untrained models and are excluded. To build training data, we sample with temperature 0.6 and top- p p 0.95 (no top- k k limit) and up to 6,144 new tokens: two responses per prompt for user suggestions and retrieved passages, and one for tool outputs and another AI’s answers, so each prompt contributes up to two training examples. Labels cost four counterfactual answers per Training question: with one piece, a counterfactual answer is the bare question, so the same four serve all types of external information and sampled responses of that question. This cost is paid once, in training; checking dependence at deployment would cost four extra generations for every answer.
blocks.zh:
在评价时,所有模型都启用了推理,使用温度为0.6,顶端-p 0.95,顶端-k k 20, a
固定种子, 最多8,192个新标志。 每个模型的2至4个截断产出来自两个训练有素的推理循环
和未受过训练的模型,并被排除在外。 为了建立培训数据,我们用温度为0.6和上-p 0.95(无最高-k k 限制)的样本以及多达6,144个新令牌:用户建议和检索段落的每个提示两个回复,工具输出和另一个AI的答案一个回复,因此每个提示最多贡献两个培训实例. 标签每个培训问题花费了4个反事实答案:用一分一分,反事实答案就是赤裸的问题,所以同样的4个服务于所有类型的外部信息,并抽样回答这个问题. 这笔费用在培训中支付一次;在部署时检查依赖性每次答复都要多花四代人的时间。

blocks.en:

blocks.en: We also tried an RL variant with the reward of Cheah et al. (2026) , 1 [ attributed = influential ] 1[\text{attributed}=\text{influential}] per rollout. It omits three parts of their setup: we do not balance influential and non-influential examples (so rarely attributing earns extra reward), we compute the loss on all completion tokens rather than on the explanation with the decision fixed, and we label influence on each rollout rather than once with the initial model. On the Test set it stays near the untrained model (balanced accuracy 0.51; attribution in 2% of influential and 0% of non-influential cases), so we report it only here. A rollout is influential if it gives the suggested answer and one counterfactual answer without the suggestion does not; attribution is read from the RELIED ON line by a keyword rule (precision 1.00 and recall 0.67–0.89 against the LLM judge). The reward has no correctness term, and all completion tokens are credited. We train GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) with LoRA (rank 64, α = 128 \alpha=128 ) from the untrained Qwen3-8B on 11,650 suggestion prompts (TriviaQA and MMLU, keeping prompts with usable counterfactual answers) with the attribution instruction: 8 rollouts per prompt at temperature 0.8, up to 4,096 new tokens, learning rate 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} (constant after 5% warmup), KL coefficient 0.02, and the DAPO loss ( Yu et al., 2025 ) with group-normalized rewards. We save a checkpoint every 50 steps and select on the Validation set with early stopping; the run stopped at step 283 of 400 when it reached its time limit. Validation balanced accuracy remains between 0.51 and 0.54 at every checkpoint (steps 50–250), and we report step 50. Throughout training, attribution in influential rollouts stays at 2–5%, close to the untrained model; since about 79% of rollouts are non-influential, a policy that never attributes already earns most of the reward, so the reward rarely observes the target behavior. Rollout accuracy also rises during training (cumulatively 0.63 after the first 20 steps and 0.79 by step 280): the policy can satisfy the reward without adopting the suggestion, making a rollout non-influential and “none” correct.

answers are longer, on 88–99%. Relabeling the training data changes 3–4% of influence labels. All reported models
are trained and evaluated with these labels.

blocks.en: K.1 What Drives the Gain
blocks.zh: K.1级 驱动收益的是什么

blocks.en: VFT’s targets keep the model’s own final attribution statement, which for influential examples usually reads “RELIED ON: none” (59% of influential training examples). To rule out that this line trains the final answer toward chance, we retrain VFT on the same data with the attribution statement excluded from the loss. On the Test set, the reasoning still acknowledges influential suggestions in 77% of cases and non-influential ones in 32% (balanced accuracy 0.73, vs. 0.74 for VFT), while the final line attributes none of the 52 influential and none of the 139 non-influential suggestions (0.50); on the Fresh set it attributes 4% of 201 influential suggestions (0.52). Acknowledgment in the reasoning does not reach the answer even when the answer is not trained toward “none”.
blocks.zh: VFT的目标保留了该模型自己的最终归属说明,对于有影响力的例子,该说明通常写作"RELIED On: no"(59%有影响力的培训例子 ). 为了排除这条线对机会进行最后的解答, 我们重新训练VFT 在相同的数据上 与归属说明 排除的损失。 在测试集上,推理仍然承认77%的案例中有影响的建议,32%的案例中没有影响的建议(平衡准确性为0.73, VFT为0.74),而最终线则没有属性52个有影响的建议,139个无影响的建议(0.50);在Fresh集上,它属性201个有影响的建议(0.52)的4%. 即使答案没有被训练成“无”的,对推理的承认也没有达到答案。

blocks.en: With labels from the same counterfactual procedure, training the attribution statement into the final answer outperforms training it into the reasoning by + 0.12 +0.12 on the Test set. VFT’s reasoning acknowledges influential suggestions, but its final answer remains at chance. This holds whether the acknowledgment appears at the start of the reasoning or where the suggestion is first used.
blocks.zh: 使用同一反事实程序的标签,将归属语句训练入最终答案比在"测试集"上通过+0.12+0.12来将其训练入推理. VFT的推理承认了有影响力的建议,但其最终答案仍然在偶然中. 这决定了承认是否出现在推理开始时,还是首先使用建议的地方。

blocks.en: Restricting the loss to tokens after the reasoning gives 0.88 balanced accuracy on the Test set. The gain therefore does not come from training the reasoning. Restricting the loss further to the attribution statement alone is degenerate: the model stops writing its final answer (109 of 120 validation responses).
blocks.zh: 将损失限制在推理后,使测试集的精确度达到0.88平衡. 因此,收益并不来自训练推理。 将损失进一步限制在归属说明之外是堕落的:模型停止了写出最终答案(120个验证答复中的109个).

blocks.en: Labels from one counterfactual answer instead of four give a similar test score (0.83; difference + 0.03 +0.03 , [ − 0.03 , 0.09 ] [-0.03,0.09] ). The ingredient that matters is supervising the final attribution statement with the model’s own counterfactual labels; more counterfactual answers make the labels more robust but are not essential.
blocks.zh: 一个反事实回答的标签而不是四个给出相似的测试分数(0.83;差分+0.03+0.03,[−0.03,0.09] [-0.03,0.09]). 重要的成分是用模型自己的反事实标签来监督最终归属表;更多的反事实答案使标签更加坚固,但并不重要.

blocks.en: Untrained 14B often mentions the suggestion even when it was non-influential, in 21% of non-influential cases. Training makes it more selective, reducing this rate to 14%.

blocks.en: K.2 Agreeing Answers
blocks.zh: K.2 同意答复

blocks.en: For answers that agree with the suggestion, the harder stratum is correct suggestions: the model may already know the answer, so agreement alone says little about influence. In this stratum, Credit reaches 0.81, 0.78, and 0.71 at 8B ( Test , Fresh , Large ), 0.80, 0.79, and 0.73 at 14B, and 0.74, 0.74, and 0.68 for DeepSeek, compared with 0.49–0.67 untrained. blocks.en: K.3 Asking the Model Whether It Knows
blocks.zh: K.3 询问模型是否知道

blocks.en: We compare Credit with P(IK) ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ) , a control that uses no attribution statement: the untrained model is asked, without reasoning, whether it knows the answer, and a lower probability of “Yes” predicts influence. Both are scored on the same agreeing answers from each Credit model, against that model’s influence labels. For P(IK), we use the threshold that maximizes balanced accuracy on each evaluation set, which favors P(IK) (Table 19 ).

blocks.en: K.4 Prompting Baselines
blocks.zh: K.4 快速基线

blocks.en: We also test a stricter instruction that states the counterfactual criterion directly: “At the end of your final answer, add one line ‘RELIED ON: …’ naming any information given to you (by the user, or in documents or passages) without which you would not have given this answer, that is, information such that, had it not been given to you, your final answer would be different. If you would have given the same answer without it, write ‘RELIED ON: none’, even if the information agrees with your answer or you discussed it in your reasoning.” On all three question sets, untrained models answer under this instruction. Counterfactual answers come from the untrained run, whose counterfactual answer prompts are identical (they contain no instruction); adoption is judged anew for each new answer, so the comparisons share counterfactual answers. The stricter wording changes how often models attribute, not whether they attribute correctly (Table 20 ): Qwen3-8B improves slightly ( + 0.04 +0.04 to + 0.07 +0.07 ) but still attributes only about one in five influential suggestions; Qwen3-14B attributes most suggestions (78–97% of influential and 44–46% of non-influential ones) and does not improve; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B also does not improve. Credit exceeds the stricter instruction by 0.13 to 0.33 for every model and question set.
blocks.zh: 我们还测试更严格的指示,直接说明反事实标准: " 在最后答复末尾,增加一行 " . " ,点出(用户或文件或段落中)提供给你的任何信息,如果没有这些信息,你就不会给出这一答案,也就是说,如果没有这些信息,你的最终答案就会不同。 如果你没有答案,就写出“没有”的回答,即使信息同意你的答复,或者你在推理中讨论了这个问题。 在所有三个问题组上,未经过训练的模型都会在本指令下回答. 反事实解答来自未受训练的运行,其反事实解答提示相同(它们没有包含指令);每个新解答被重新判断采用,因此比较共享反事实解答. 更严格的措辞改变了模型属性的频率,而不是它们是否正确属性(表20): Qune3-8B稍有改进(+0.04+0.04到+0.07+0.07),但仍只有大约五分之一的有影响力的建议属性; Qune3-14B赋予大多数建议(78-97%有影响力,44-46%无影响力),没有改进; DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-7B也没有改进. 每套模型和问题集的信用超过更严格的指示0.13至0.33.

blocks.en: K.5 A Llama-Based Model
blocks.zh: K.5 基于Llama的模型

blocks.en: The three main models are built on Qwen bases. To test another model family, we apply the same pipeline, unchanged, to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B ( Guo et al., 2025 ) (one training seed). Credit raises balanced accuracy from 0.62 to 0.85 on the Test set (omitted: 56% → \to 19%; falsely attributed: 19% → \to 12%), from 0.62 to 0.79 on the Fresh set, and from 0.59 to 0.79 on the Large set. Transfer follows the pattern of the Qwen models ( Test set, untrained → \to Credit ): tool outputs 0.60 → \to 0.80, another AI’s answer 0.66 → \to 0.82, the unseen types question metadata 0.57 → \to 0.63 and claimed expertise 0.62 → \to 0.71, and no gain for system-prompt notes (0.51 → \to 0.50). Among answers that agree with the suggestion, where answer matching is at chance, Credit scores 0.77, 0.67, and 0.71 on the Test , Fresh , and Large sets. Overall, Credit and the answer-matching rule are close on the Test set (0.85 vs. 0.80; difference [ − 0.01 , 0.11 ] [-0.01,0.11] ) and the Fresh set (0.79 vs. 0.78), and the matching rule is ahead on the Large set (0.82 vs. 0.79), as it is for DeepSeek-R1-7B (0.87 vs. 0.80).
blocks.zh: 三大型号以奎恩为基地. 为了测试另一个模范家族,我们用同样的管道,不变地应用到DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B(Guo等人,2025年)(一粒训练种子). 信用使测试组的平衡精度从0.62提高到了0.85(通过:56%~~~到19%;错误的归属:19%~~到12%);新鲜组的平衡精度从0.62提高到了0.79;大型组的平衡精度从0.59提高到了0.79。 转帐遵循了Quen模型的模式(测试集,未经训练 ~\ to Credit ):工具输出0.60~\至0.80,另一个AI的回答0.66~\至0.82,隐形类型质疑元数据0.57~\至0.63,并声称专长0.62~\至0.71,系统即时音符没有收益(0.51~\至0.50). 在同意这项建议的答案中,如果答案匹配是偶然的,那么信用在测试、新鲜和大型组合上评分为0.77分、0.67分和0.71分。 总体而言,信用和答对规则接近于测试集(0.85对0.80;差分[−0.01,0.11][-0.01,0.11])和新鲜集(0.79对0.78),匹配规则领先于大集(0.82对0.79),如DeepSeek-R1-7B(0.87对0.80).

blocks.en: K.6 Transfer and System-Prompt Notes
blocks.zh: K.6 转移和系统临时说明

blocks.en: The attribution instruction names information given “by the user, or in documents or passages”, which could exclude system prompts. With “in the system prompt” added to that list, system-prompt balanced accuracy rises only slightly: untrained Qwen3-8B 0.62 → \to 0.68 on the Test set ( + 0.06 +0.06 , [ − 0.03 , 0.15 ] [-0.03,0.15] ) and 0.59 → \to 0.63 on the Fresh set ( + 0.04 +0.04 , [ 0.00 , 0.08 ] [0.00,0.08] ); Credit 0.63 → \to 0.66 ( + 0.02 +0.02 , [ − 0.06 , 0.10 ] [-0.06,0.10] ) and 0.63 → \to 0.67 ( + 0.05 +0.05 , [ 0.01 , 0.08 ] [0.01,0.08] ). Credit still attributes only 34–37% of influential system-prompt notes, while the other types change by at most 0.05. The system-prompt failure is therefore not an artifact of the instruction’s wording. As in the stricter-instruction run, counterfactual answers are reused from each model’s standard run and adoption is judged anew.
blocks.zh: 归属指示将“用户”或文件或段落中提供的信息命名,这可能会排除系统提示。 由于该列表中添加了"系统快取",系统即时平衡精度只略微上升:在测试集(+0.06+0.06, [−0.03, 0.15])和新鲜集(+0.04+0.04, [0.00, 0.08] [0.00, 0.08]); 在测试集(+0.02+0.02, [-0.06, 0.10])和0.63+0.67(+0.05, [0.01, 0.08])上, 信用仍仅赋予34-37%的有影响力的系统发音,而其他类型则以最多0.05来变化. 因此,系统即时失效并不是该指示措辞的产物。 与更严格的指令运行一样,反事实答案从每个模型的标准运行中重复使用,并重新判断采用。

blocks.en: The two additional Qwen3-8B training runs give 0.73 and 0.75 on unseen metadata, 0.82 and 0.82 on claimed expertise, and 0.63 and 0.60 on system-prompt notes.
blocks.zh: 增加的两次Qune3-8B培训就未发现的元数据提供0.73和0.75,就声称的专门知识提供0.82和0.82,就系统即时说明提供0.63和0.60。

blocks.en: The transfer pattern replicates on the Fresh set for Qwen3-8B: tool output 0.71 → \to 0.82, another AI’s answer 0.53 → \to 0.83, metadata 0.58 → \to 0.74, claimed expertise 0.69 → \to 0.81, and system-prompt note 0.59 → \to 0.63.
blocks.zh: 转接模式在Fresh集上复制了Qwen3-8B:工具输出0.71~\至0.82,另一个AI的回答为0.53~\至0.83,元数据为0.58~\至0.74,声称拥有专业知识0.69~\至0.81,系统即时注释为0.59~\至0.63.

blocks.en: With a neutral system-prompt note (“Context: the answer to the user’s question is X X ”), the model almost always follows the note: accuracy with a wrong note is 0.05 untrained and 0.01 after training. Yet the trained model attributes its answer to it in 2% of influential cases (balanced accuracy 0.51), below the untrained model (0.58). System-prompt notes are the only type of external information our method does not reach.
blocks.zh: 使用中性系统即时注释("Context:对用户问题的答案是X X"),该模型几乎总是沿用该注释:有错误注释的准确性为0.05未受训练后为0.01. 然而,经过培训的模型将答案归结于2%的有影响力的案例(平衡准确度为0.51),低于未经培训的模型(0.58)。 系统即时笔记是我们的方法无法触及的唯一类型的外部信息.

blocks.en: K.7 Benchmark Passages
blocks.zh: K.7 基准通过

blocks.en: On FaithEval, the 95% CIs of the three seeds’ gains over the untrained model are [ 0.03 , 0.18 ] [0.03,0.18] , [ 0.03 , 0.18 ] [0.03,0.18] , and [ 0.10 , 0.24 ] [0.10,0.24] .

The untrained model almost always attributes its answer to the passage, whether or not the passage was influential: 98% when influential and 65% when non-influential. The trained models continue to attribute their answers to the passage when it was influential (86–92%) and mostly stop otherwise (21–38%). Training on user suggestions alone collapses passage self-attribution here (0.56; 15% when influential). Our faithfulness-RL variant leaves the untrained behavior unchanged (0.65), and VFT lowers it (0.59; difference to the untrained model [ − 0.13 , − 0.02 ] [-0.13,-0.02] ).
blocks.zh: 未经过训练的模型几乎总是将答案归结于通过,无论通过是否具有影响力:98%有影响力,65%无影响力. 训练有素的模型继续将答案归结于有影响力的通道(86-92%),大部分停止了其他方式(21-38%)。 仅就用户建议进行的培训就使通过自我归属(0.56;有影响力时为15%)。 我们的忠诚-RL变体使未受训练的行为保持不变(0.65),而VFT则降低(0.59;与未受训练的模型的区别[−0.13,−0.02] [-0.13,-0.02]).

blocks.en: On RAMDocs, misinformation is rarely influential (5–8 influential cases), too few to compute balanced accuracy. These labels use one counterfactual answer: the question without the passage, or with only the clean documents. FaithEval answers are multiple-choice letters, so adoption is matched exactly.
blocks.zh: 在RAMDocs上,错误信息很少有影响(5至8个有影响的案例),太少无法计算均衡的准确性. 这些标签使用一个反事实答案:没有通过的问题,或者只有干净的文件. 信仰 Eval的回答是多选择字母,所以收养是完全匹配的.

blocks.en: K.8 Competing External Information
blocks.zh: K.8 竞争的外部信息

blocks.en: The source-aware answer-matching rule attributes a piece whenever the model gives that piece’s answer. On Credit ’s answers, it scores 0.84, 0.82, and 0.97 on the Test set and 0.84, 0.82, and 0.96 on the Fresh set (8B, 14B, DeepSeek), matching or exceeding Credit (0.78, 0.82, 0.78 and 0.75, 0.79, 0.77). Among pieces whose answer the model gives, where the matching rule is at chance, Credit reaches 0.73, 0.77, and 0.72 on the Test set and 0.70, 0.74, and 0.69 on the Fresh set, versus 0.50, 0.45, and 0.57 and 0.49, 0.48, and 0.56 untrained.
blocks.zh: 源头意识的答案比对规则在模型给出一个部件的答案时会赋予它属性. 根据信用的答案,它得分为:测试组0.84分,0.82分和0.97分;Fresh组0.84分,0.82分和0.96分(8B分,14B分,DeepSeek分),匹配或超过信用(0.78分,0.82分,0.78分和0.75分,0.79分,0.77分. 在模型给出的答案中,如果匹配规则是偶然的,则在测试组上信用达到0.73分,0.77分,在测试组上信用达到0.72分,在Fresh组上信用达到0.70分,在0.74分,在0.69分,在0.50分,0.45分,在0.57分和0.49分,0.48分和0.56分,未受过训练.

blocks.en: For Qwen, Credit ’s gain under competition comes mostly from fewer false attributions to the non-influential piece (8B: 15% → \to 5%; 14B: 23% → \to 7%); for DeepSeek, from naming the influential piece more often (28% → \to 60%).
blocks.zh: 对Quen来说,竞争下的信用收益主要来自对无影响力作品的虚假归属较少(8B:15%~~~~5%;14B:23%~~7%);对DeepSeek来说,从更频繁地命名有影响力的作品(28~~~~60%).

blocks.en: With three competing pieces, the 8B gain holds (0.74 → \to 0.86 on the Fresh set; 0.78 → \to 0.85 on the Test set), mainly through fewer false attributions (12% → \to 4%); at 14B it is clear on the Test set (0.77 → \to 0.84) but small on the Fresh set (0.78 → \to 0.79).
blocks.zh: 3个相竞的棋子,8B增益持有(0.74 ~\至0.86在新鲜套上;0.78 →\至0.85在测试套上),主要通过较少的假归属(12% →\至4%);14B在测试套上清楚(0.77 →\至0.84),但在新鲜套上小(0.78 →\至0.79).

blocks.en:
The 105-question Test set gives the same pattern as the Fresh set (Table 4 ) (8B 0.66 → \to 0.78,
0.77 with multi-source examples; 14B 0.65 → \to 0.82, 0.84 with multi-source examples; DeepSeek 0.60 → \to 0.78, 0.83 with multi-source examples).
blocks.zh:
105个问题 测试集给出了与"新鲜"集相同的模式(表4)(8B 0.66 ~\至 0.78).
有多来源实例的0.77; 有多来源实例的14B 0.65 → \to 0.82, 有多来源实例的0.84; 有多来源实例的DeepSeek 0.60 → \to 0.78, 有多来源实例的0.83.

blocks.en: With a single piece of external information, the influential piece is always one whose answer the model gives, so matching the answer to the piece already identifies every influential case. We therefore also place two pieces with conflicting answers in one prompt. Matching remains informative there, since it points to the piece whose answer the model gives, but that piece may still be non-influential, and the rule must know which source proposed which answer. One piece gives the wrong answer and the other the correct one, delivered as a user suggestion and a tool output, or as another AI’s answer and question metadata, in both role assignments. Each piece is scored separately. It is influential if the model gives its answer with both pieces present but rarely when only the other piece remains (four counterfactual answers). Because two pieces are present, an attribution counts only if t t names that piece’s source, so naming the other piece is an error. Except for the multi-source variant (Table 4 ), no model was trained on prompts with more than one piece.
blocks.zh: 有了单一的外部信息,有影响力的作品总是一个模型给出的答案,因此将答案与作品相匹配,已经识别出每一个有影响力的案件. 因此,我们还将两个有相互矛盾的答案的问题一一提出。 火柴在那里仍然信息丰富,因为它指模型给出的答案所在的作品,但该作品可能仍然没有意义,规则必须知道哪个来源提出了哪个答案. 一部给出了错误的答案,另一部给出了正确的答案,作为用户建议和工具输出,或者作为另一部AI的答案和提问元数据,在两个角色任务中都给出了正确答案. 每分分分分分分. 如果模型给出答案,同时同时呈现出两个片段,但当只有另一个片段留下(四个反事实答案)时却很少出现,那就很有影响力了. 因为有两块存在,一个归属只有在该片源的t t名称时才算数,所以给另一块取名是一个错误. 除多源变体(表4)外,没有用多块来培训任何模型。

blocks.en: When the influential piece is another AI’s answer, the Qwen Credit models attribute the answer to it in only 8–9% of cases.
blocks.zh: 当有影响力的作品是AI的另一个答案时,Quen Credit模型将答案归属于它只有8-9%的案例.

blocks.en: Adding two-piece prompts to training does not raise accuracy for the Qwen models (8B: 0.74 vs. 0.75; 14B: 0.80 vs. 0.79), but does for DeepSeek-R1-7B (0.77 → \to 0.82). It shifts which external information types are attributed (another AI’s answer 9% → \to 23%, user suggestion 43% → \to 53%, tool output 87% → \to 76%) and keeps false attributions low (3%), but the 8B model still omits about half of the influential pieces.
blocks.zh: 在训练中加入两件的提示不会提高Quen型号的精度(8B:0.74对0.75;14B:0.80对0.79),而是对DeepSeek-R1-7B(0.77~\==0.82). 它将哪些外部信息类型被归结(另一个AI的回答为9%~\%到23%,用户建议为43%~\%到53%,工具输出为87%~\%到76%)并保持了虚假归属低(3%),但8B模型仍然省略了约一半有影响力的作品.

blocks.en: The added examples improve single-piece self-attribution on the Test set (user suggestions 0.86 → \to 0.89; another AI’s answer 0.81 → \to 0.88).
blocks.zh: 新增的例子改善了测试集单件自我归属(用户建议0.86 →\至0.89;另一个AI的回答0.81 →\至0.88).

blocks.en: K.9 Why Not Re-Run the Model?
blocks.zh: K.9 为什么不能重跑模型?

blocks.en:
Influence is defined by intervention, so re-running the model without each item of external information
is the reference standard: a single extra suggestion-free sample recovers our four-sample labels with balanced accuracy of about
0.97 (an optimistic estimate, since that sample is one of the four). It is, however, an external audit rather than an
account given by the model. It needs one or more additional reasoning generations per candidate item of external information for every
answer, it assumes each item of external information can be removed without changing the task (easy for a user’s suggestion, not for a
system prompt, a tool output inside an agent loop, or the conversation history), and it is unavailable to a user who
receives a single response. The cost grows with the amount of external information: with two pieces, identifying
the influential one already requires a separate set of counterfactual answers per piece (eight extra generations per answer in our
setup), and pieces that matter only jointly would require counterfactual answers for combinations. Credit moves this cost to training:
it uses counterfactual answering to build labels once and teaches the model to state, in a single pass, what the intervention would
have shown, and this single-pass self-attribution partially transfers to prompts with competing pieces (Section 7 ).
